senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בט , v. בטי; cmp. רָוַח) to be at ease, without trouble, whence to trust.
units: Ber. 6ᵇ הו״ל לבְטוֹחַ וכ׳ he ought to have trusted in the name of the Lord, but did not trust.—Part. pass. בָּטוּחַ assured.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 4:6:5">Y. Naz. IV, end, 53ᶜ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31">Lev. R. s. 31</cite> <he>ב׳ שגוזר</he> he may rest assured that &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:13">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>הבטחה שה׳</he> the assurance which the Lord has given.

Pesik. R. s. 1, beg. אע״פ שמתו המַבְטִיחִין וכ׳ though those who gave the assurances, the prophets, are dead, but the Lord who promised (through them) is ever-living; a. fr.—Part. Hof. מוּבְטָח (= בָּטוּחַ) confident, sure.
<cite ref="Berakhot 4a:14">Ber. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ אני בך וכ׳</he> I am sure that thou rewardest &c.
